roles.drugs: Carbidopa/levodopa: the mainstay and most effective treatment; early use does not hasten loss of effect
MAO-B inhibitors (selegiline, rasagiline): mild symptoms as monotherapy, or with levodopa

Dopamine agonists (pramipexole, ropinirole, rotigotine) instead of or with levodopa; apomorphine SL/SC as rescue for severe 'off' episodes. Bromocriptine: your table; MSD says its North American use is largely limited to pituitary adenomas (valve and pleural fibrosis)

roles.drugs: Amantadine: early mild disease (often loses effect after months); best option for levodopa-induced dyskinesias
Anticholinergics (benztropine, trihexyphenidyl): usually only young patients with tremor-predominant disease
COMT inhibitors with levodopa for wearing-off: entacapone; tolcapone (liver enzymes monitored); opicapone
Levodopa-induced hallucinations or delirium: quetiapine or clozapine (they don't worsen parkinsonism); avoid other antipsychotics
